message.content: It started about eight days ago as a mild pain in the upper left part of my belly. It came on gradually. I was told it was probably a stomach bug (gastroenteritis), but it never got better, and now it's a lot worse, with nausea and vomiting. I'm not sure what makes it better or worse. As for what it feels like and how bad it is on a 0-10 scale, I haven't described that in detail, so I can't give you a precise number. It's just clearly worse than when it began.
